record.question: What is the purpose of performing a 'darkroom fog test' as part of a quality assurance program?
options: To measure the accuracy of the kVp setting.
To check for light leaks and unsafe safelight conditions in the darkroom.
To determine the proper exposure technique for a patient.
To test the effectiveness of the processing chemicals.
record.explanation: Answer B: To check for light leaks and unsafe safelight conditions in the darkroom.. A fog test checks unintended darkroom light exposure, including leaks/safelight effects. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
